dashboard.lead: Your orders, your library and everything Efendi remembers about you.

orders.title: My orders
orders.lead: Orders you placed as a guest with your account's email appear here too, once it's verified.
orders.notFound: We couldn't find this order in your account.

chats.title: My chats with Efendi
chats.text: Your chats with Efendi will be saved here, so you can come back and carry on where you left off.
chats.soon: The smart assistant is being set up; we'll notify you when it launches.

following.title: Editor alerts
following.lead: We tell you in your notifications and by email when an editor you follow publishes a new edition.
following.none: You don't follow any editors yet. Press “Follow” on any editor's page.

wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.none: You haven't saved any books yet. Press ♡ on any book to save it here.

library.title: My library
library.lead: Everything you bought, and books you own that you've added, with your reading progress.
library.empty: Your shelf is empty for now. Books you buy appear here automatically.
library.emptyHint: Own books from elsewhere? Open the book's page and choose “I own this book”.

points.title: Points
points.lead: You earn points with every order. Spending points at checkout is coming soon.
points.disabled: The points programme isn't active right now.
points.pendingNote: Points from new orders stay “pending” until the return period ends.
points.none: No activity yet. Your points will appear here after your first order.

tx.RedemptionReversed: Given back after a cancelled order

paths.left: You left the path. You can come back to it any time.
paths.finished: You've completed this path. May Allah bless your knowledge.
paths.title: My paths
paths.lead: Your progress comes from your library: each book you finish completes its stage.
paths.none: You haven't started a reading path yet.

notifications.shipped: Your order {{number}} has shipped. You can follow it from the order page.
notifications.priceDropFrom: The price of {{book}} dropped from {{old}} to {{new}}.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: We'll let you know here when your orders ship, a book is back in stock, a price drops, or an editor you follow publishes.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.lead: Save up to {{n}} addresses to choose from at checkout.
addresses.full: You've reached the limit. Delete an address to add another.

validation.label: Give the address a name, such as Home
validation.phoneRequired: Enter a phone number; couriers can't deliver without one

reviews.savedEdit: Changes saved; your review will appear once it's been checked.
reviews.rejectedNote: It wasn't published because it doesn't follow the review guidelines. You can edit it and send it again.
reviews.title: My reviews
reviews.lead: A review appears to everyone once we've checked it, and so does every edit.
reviews.none: You haven't written any reviews yet. Once your order arrives, you can rate books from their pages.

profile.title: My details
profile.phoneHint: We use it to fill in the phone field at checkout.
profile.emailLanguageHint: We send order and account emails in this language.
profile.marketing: Email me about new releases and offers

password.doneText: We signed you out on every device to keep your account safe. Sign in with your new password.
password.title: Change password
password.lead: After the change we sign you out on every device, this one included.

delete.done: Your account has been deleted. We hope to see you again.
delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Deletion is permanent and can't be undone: your addresses, wishlist and reviews are deleted, and your orders are kept without your personal details for invoicing.
delete.confirm: I understand that deleting my account is permanent

validation.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from your current one
validation.confirmDelete: Confirm that you understand deletion is permanent
